notes.title: Partner programme planning
notes.plan:
A long session on the partner tiers, the onboarding and the regional launch.

## Action plan
### Rochelle
- [ ] Draft the description of the three partner tiers and what each gets
- [ ] Collect feedback from the five pilot partners on the onboarding checklist
### Daniel
- [ ] Prepare the regional launch timeline with dates for each region
### You
- [ ] Get the partner marketing budget approved by the leadership team
- [ ] Book the venue for the partner training day

## Decisions
- Three tiers: registered, select and premier.
- The pilot partners get premier for the first year.

## Open questions
- Does the premier tier include co-branded materials?
